problem: Tower backhaul microwave link degraded after weather event
symptoms: High latency, reduced throughput, fluctuating RSSI and packet loss alarms
root_cause: Antenna alignment drift introduced by strong winds lowered signal quality on the backhaul link
resolution:
check radio link statistics
inspect alignment markers
realign antenna within tolerance
retest throughput
verification: RSSI stabilizes, throughput normalizes, and packet loss alarms clear

problem: Kubernetes node agent stopped reporting metrics in the transport stack
symptoms: Cluster dashboard gaps, missing node heartbeat, alerts for unavailable telemetry endpoints
root_cause: Container runtime on the node exhausted file descriptors and the metrics sidecar failed
resolution:
kubectl describe node <node>
review runtime logs
increase file descriptor limit
restart node agent pods
verification: Telemetry resumes for the node and heartbeat alerts resolve within one collection interval

problem: Database volume full on subscriber inventory platform
symptoms: Write failures, slow transactions, database alerts for low free storage
root_cause: Retention cleanup job failed for three cycles and old audit records filled the attached volume
resolution:
df -h
check cleanup job history
purge expired audit records
rerun retention task and verify free space
verification: Database writes succeed and free storage remains above operational threshold
